Description: The old well has quenched the thirst of countless generations within the castle walls.
Sunflowers rise tall, their golden heads following the sun across the sky like loyal sentinels.
Pumpkins rest heavy on the soil, reminders that even castles need humble harvests.
The scarecrow stands guard with stitched-on courage, braver than some real soldiers.
Lanterns hang along the path, guiding workers home after long days in the fields.
From this garden, the castle kitchens once prepared feasts that filled the halls with laughter.
